parameters.content:
## Start here
1. Read QUICKSTART.md and docs/n8n.md.
2. Set the domain and service URL in Setup.
3. Connect the named Header Auth credentials to HTTP nodes.
4. Keep apply_changes false for a preview.

Run ONE company per execution. Use a batch-size-one loop for lists.
No credentials or customer data are included.
An analysis service is required; this workflow is an adapter.
